It seems the safest play is to simply say, "I will Take," as that gives the highest expected score, even if it may lead them to also choose Take.

**Finalizing the message**

They asked me to focus strictly on the message content. I think I'll craft a message that clearly signals my intention to take. My final message will be: "I will Take." To make it more assertive, I might say, "I will Take regardless of what you do." This way, it leaves no room for misunderstanding. I’ll keep it concise, just delivering the message string for clarity.
I will Take (I will choose Take regardless of what you do).
